card.name: Go and going in spoken quotes
card.fires_on: Forms of the verb go (going, go, went) right after a speaker's pronoun in quoted or spoken speech, as in "I'm going to". It also fires weakly on filler words in teacher talk, such as kind, keep, really, lot.

modes.label: Going to in speech
modes.description: The word going or go after I, we or you in quoted speech, often leading into a plan.
modes.example: "We're learning about ROVs, but we're also<< going>> to learn about AUVs" -

modes.label: Casual words in classroom talk
modes.description: Informal words such as kind, keep, really, lot in transcribed teacher or guide dialogue.

card.plain: It lights up on the word go or going in conversational speech, like "I was going to", and a bit on casual spoken filler.
